scope: All 192 branch heads observed in the 13 nonempty public repositories of the connected author account, before creation of the isolated Palomar candidate branch, plus the five named published Zenodo ZIP snapshots. This is a frozen inventory, not all Git history, not a live branch scan, and not every Lean development ever mentioned in the programme. Non-public and unlocated sources are excluded.
method: Each retrieved GitHub blob was checked against its Git object SHA-1 and size. Archive SHA-256 values match the recorded public archive audit. Lean content is deduplicated by SHA-256. Tokens, imports and declarations are lexical observations after removing comments and strings; they do not establish compilation, theorem closure, permitted axioms, originality or scientific importance.
